title: Slider Frame
description: The wrapper for a carousel, supplying the arrow and dot presentation the live site uses on its homepage and single-page sliders. The nav itself is drawn by whichever carousel is inside — Slick under Tour Operator, Swiper under the Carousel Block — so neither set of markup is ours to put in a block-style JSON. This style declares the three values as custom properties on the group and assets/styles/core-group.css binds them to both vendors' hooks, which is the pattern in wp-thirdparty-markup-styling: scope to the is-style class so natural specificity wins without !important. Measured on the live site 2026-08-20: arrows #B4A48C on a 50% radius with a 2px transparent border; dots #938673, also fully round.
